text:
tara_marketing: Noticed a drift: inbound leads stuck in 'enriching' and holding claim spots. Small percent but impacting time-to-first-touch SLA. Anyone free to triage?

ben_salesops: Seen this. Suggest a rapid-fallback path so owners aren't blocked during enrichment retries.

anya_revops: Proposal: 1) heartbeat job every 5m to detect stuck enrichments, 2) move to DLQ after 2 failed attempts OR claim_age > 15m, 3) SDR fallback pool + Slack digest.

dev_li: I can ship the probe. Simple logic: if enrich_status==failed OR (pending && claim_age>15m) then tag manual_enrich_needed and move to DLQ. Check owner_out_of_office flag first.

ben_salesops: Also shorten claim TTL for inbound from 60m -> 15m and add small jitter (0-90s) so bursts don't serially block rotation.

anya_revops: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow: when manual_enrich_needed -> clear owner after 30m and set enrichment_flag; create SF sync to annotate. Will include SDR playbook. ETA EOD tomorrow.

tara_marketing: Priority order: heartbeat + DLQ + Slack digest, claim TTL tweak + jitter, HS workflow + SF tag, SDR playbook.

runbot: scheduled job created: inbound-enrich-heartbeat cron: */5 * * * * (staging).

dev_li: I'll canary in staging and post results. If green, we push to prod and monitor claim-occupancy and time_to_first_touch metrics.

ben_salesops: Sounds good. Quick test after staging please. :thumbsup:
